items.action: Upgrade PHP immediately on all internet-facing servers; no WAF or app-level fix removes the engine flaw. If patching is delayed, NSA/NCSC guidance is to take affected systems offline and investigate for prior compromise.
items.details: Flaws affect all PHP versions from 5.4 onward; unauthenticated attackers can achieve remote code execution. Cloudflare's CEO said the network has seen millions of exploitation attempts in the past two days. Discovered by Wiz, OpenAI's Patch the Planet and Calif; AI assistance was key to turning a complex memory-safety bug chain into a working exploit.
items.summary: Emergency patches released Oct 21 for two decade-old critical PHP flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2), dubbed PHP2Shell, affecting up to 70% of the web's server-side language footprint. Wikipedia and the Internet Archive briefly went offline to patch.
items.title: PHP2Shell: critical RCE flaws hit PHP — emergency patching underway

items.action: Rotate every environment variable and private registry credential, generate new Railway API/project tokens, reconnect GitHub, redeploy services using storage buckets, and scan usage for AI API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, OpenRouter), Stripe, AWS, GCP and GitHub.
items.details: Detection Oct 21; Railway invalidated all API tokens Oct 22 (pre-incident tokens remain dead) and reset every storage-bucket credential plus the GitHub tokens it held. External analysis linked suspected credential abuse to ~$371K in crypto drains across 19 chains — not yet confirmed by Railway. Railway believes this fits a broader pattern of attacks on platform companies targeting AI-inference provider keys.
items.summary: Cloud platform Railway disclosed Oct 21 that a third party may have accessed encrypted environment variables and obtained decrypted contents for some. Customers are told to roll all secrets; deployments were paused and are being restored in stages.
items.title: Railway discloses security incident; customers must rotate all secrets

items.action: If Quest or your provider notifies you that your records were affected, follow its official protective guidance; watch for phishing using lab-result lures.
items.details: Quest notified federal law enforcement and engaged external cybersecurity experts. Scope (patient count, data categories, attacker identity, entry method) remains under investigation; no ransomware/extortion attribution established. Disclosure filed under 8-K Item 8.01 (incident not yet judged material).
items.summary: Quest Diagnostics filed an SEC 8-K on Oct 22: on Oct 21 it learned an unauthorized party had accessed its Quanum LSM portal (used by clients to place test orders and look up results) and believes certain patient records were accessed. Operations not materially disrupted.
items.title: Quest Diagnostics discloses unauthorized access to patient records portal

items.action: Treat leak-site claims as a verification trigger, not proof: check privileged access, auth logs, backups, and confirm no ransom contact before engaging.
items.details: Reportedly the Mimori entry names AVEVA, cites 177,234 files and a publication date of Oct 23, 2026. Nothing in the public record independently confirms intrusion, data theft, or a ransom demand. Leak-site listings are often extortion pressure first and evidence second.
items.summary: A leak-site listing attributed to Mimori names industrial-software firm AVEVA, citing ~177K files with a publication date of Oct 23 — unverified, no breach or data theft confirmed.
items.title: Mimori leak-site listing names AVEVA; claim unverified

items.action: If this is your vendor or appears in your threat feeds, treat as unverified until confirmed; monitor the group's leak page for any data publication.
items.details: HookPhish's incident record lists target istanbultrading.com (TR, retail & e-commerce), threat group lockbit5, discovered 2026-10-22. LockBit's previous operation was dismantled in 2024; successor branding continues under new versions.
items.summary: LockBit5 named istanbultrading.com on its leak feed on Oct 22, claiming a ransomware incident — a threat-feed claim, not a confirmed breach.
items.title: LockBit5 claims istanbultrading.com ransomware hit

items.action: Update browsers and operating systems so the new distrust rules reach every device; find and replace any certificates chaining to the affected eMudhra roots, and never bypass certificate warnings.
items.details: The P-384 private keys were tiny single-byte values (4, 56, 66, 115, 155, 156, 230, 237), recoverable in under a second — a 2025 key-ceremony script bug is blamed. Google/Mozilla blocked the affected TLS intermediates Oct 17; Apple blocked Oct 19, Microsoft Oct 20; eMudhra revoked all eight intermediates Oct 18. ~30,000 certificates need migration. CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0050 (Oct 21). eMudhra says its Indian DSC/eSign services run on separate systems and its infrastructure was not breached.
items.summary: Bengaluru CA eMudhra is exiting the global SSL/TLS business after researchers recovered eight intermediate private keys generated with almost no randomness. Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft distrusted the certificates; the stock crashed ~20% and the government called a high-level review on Oct 23.
items.title: eMudhra exits global SSL business after private-key blunder; govt probe ordered

items.action: Treat any SBI-related loan/account data as potentially circulating; watch for targeted phishing and fraudulent loan applications using KYC documents.
items.details: This follows an earlier claim flagged Oct 16 by OSINT account CyberPulse56 of a threat actor 'Siriusim' claiming ~375,000 CSV rows + 2,722 PDFs allegedly linked to SBI — authenticity unverified and a separate, unconfirmed claim.
items.summary: State Bank of India reported on Oct 21 that a cyberattack led to 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information being disclosed on the dark web.
items.title: SBI reports cyberattack; 3,897 customer records on dark web

items.details: The claims remain unverified; SBI had not responded to queries and it is unclear whether the records are genuine or originated from SBI's systems. This is separate from the 3,897-record incident SBI itself reported.
items.summary: On Oct 20, Indian media reported that cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse56 flagged a hacker group named 'Siriusim' claiming ~3.75 lakh SBI-linked records in CSV format plus 2,722 PDFs (personal details, loan applications, account-opening forms). Unverified allegation.
items.title: Hacker group 'Siriusim' claims 3.75 lakh SBI records (unverified)
